name: Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card

localized_names.en: Atmos™ Rewards Visa Signature® Business Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $70 for the company and $25 per additional card.

apr.notes: APR not available from page text; page uses dynamic placeholders (ProdStanMinRate% to ProdStanMaxRate% Variable APR). See Bank of America for current APR.

credit_required.notes: Not stated on the official product page.

base_rate.description: 1 point for every $1 spent on all other purchases

categories.label: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases
Gas, EV charging, shipping, local transit (including rideshare)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points are Alaska Mileage Plan miles. Redeem for flights on Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, oneworld Alliance members, and Global Partners to 1,000+ destinations. No blackout dates on Alaska/Hawaiian flights. 10% rewards bonus on all points if company has eligible BofA small business account.

signup_bonus.description: Limited-time offer: 70,000 bonus miles and a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) after $4,000 in purchases within first 90 days.

benefits.title: $99 Companion Fare (Annual)
benefits.description: $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) every year that you spend at least $6,000 on purchases with your card.

benefits.title: Free Checked Bag
benefits.description: Free checked bag and preferred boarding benefits for any cardholder when the Atmos Rewards Business Card is used to purchase Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines tickets.

benefits.title: Preferred Boarding
benefits.description: Preferred boarding when paying for Alaska/Hawaiian Airlines flight with card.

benefits.title: 20% Back on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 20% back on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines inflight purchases when paying with card.

benefits.title: $100 off Alaska Lounge+ Membership
benefits.description: $100 off annual Alaska Lounge+ Membership purchased with card.

benefits.title: 10% Rewards Bonus with BofA Small Business Account
benefits.description: 10% rewards bonus on all points earned from card purchases if your company has an eligible Bank of America small business account.

benefits.title: No International Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No international transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free checked bag for cardholder when paying for Alaska/Hawaiian Airlines flight with card
other: Annual $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes/fees from $23) after $6,000 spend per year
10% rewards bonus with eligible BofA small business account

notes: Atmos Rewards Visa Signature Business Card (rebrand of Alaska Airlines credit cards). $70 annual fee for company + $25 per card. 3X Alaska/Hawaiian, 2X gas/EV/shipping/transit, 1X other. 70K bonus miles + $99 Companion Fare after $4K in 90 days. No international transaction fees. APR not extractable (dynamic placeholders). credit_required set to null (was 'excellent' from NerdWallet, not from official page).
